summary: Register each DER in an aggregation with MISO before market participation.
full_text: Verdant Grid shall register each distributed energy resource participating in a MISO aggregation prior to the resource's first market activity, providing physical location and operational characteristics per the MISO tariff.
source_authority: FERC Order 2222 §35.28(g)(1)(ix)(B); MISO Tariff Module C §38.6

summary: Maintain telemetry feed for aggregated DER resources.
full_text: Verdant Grid's DER aggregation operations shall maintain a continuous telemetry feed to MISO for all aggregated resources participating in wholesale markets.

summary: Honor RTO-set minimum aggregation size thresholds where applicable.
full_text: Where the RTO establishes a minimum size requirement for DER aggregations, Verdant Grid's aggregation offers shall meet or exceed the published threshold.

summary: Meter each DER's per-resource output within the aggregation.
full_text: Verdant Grid shall meter each distributed energy resource's individual output at interval granularity required for RTO settlement, independent of the aggregated meter.

summary: Settle DER aggregation market revenues per MISO's settlement calendar.
full_text: Verdant Grid shall receive settlement payments from MISO for cleared DER aggregation offers and remit customer shares per the DER aggregator agreement.
source_authority: FERC Order 2222 §35.28(g)(1)(ix); MISO Tariff Module A §7.4

summary: Notify DER aggregation participants ahead of dispatch instructions.
full_text: Verdant Grid shall provide pre-dispatch notification to each DER aggregation participant per the terms of the customer DER aggregation agreement.
source_authority: Verdant Grid DER Aggregation Terms of Service §6.1

summary: Monthly outage reporting to the state PUC.
full_text: Verdant Grid shall submit a monthly outage report covering sustained interruptions by distribution feeder to the state Public Utility Commission by the 10th of the following month.

summary: Annual Renewable Portfolio Standard filing to the state PUC.
full_text: Verdant Grid shall file an annual RPS compliance filing listing retired RECs by month and sources procured.
